parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 14 - Sword Art Online

Overview

Infinity Mage (Endless) is a Secret Limited unit. She is only obtainable via evolving Infinity Mage.

Evolving

Infinity Mage (Endless) can be evolved from Infinity Mage with the following materials:

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Passive Ability: Hexed

Similar to Sukuno's Dismember, she has either 20% (Upgrades 4-6), or 25% (Upgrade 7+) chance to Hex enemies - enemies affected this way take 30% more Magic damage permanently.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
